title: Village Greek Salad
description: Cucumber, tomato, and olives under a thick slab of feta.
imageAlt: Greek salad with tomatoes, cucumber, olives, and feta
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, sliced into rings
½ small red onion, thinly sliced

steps.title: Build the salad
steps.text: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion, and olives in a wide bowl. Season lightly with salt.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Pour the oil and vinegar over the vegetables and toss.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Set the feta on top, scatter with oregano, and add a last thread of oil.
